test_paddleocr_vl_image_processing_pil: test the PaddleOCRVL image processor with PIL images for single and batched inputs
test_paddleocr_vl_image_processing_numpy: test the PaddleOCRVL image processor with numpy array inputs for single and batched processing
test_paddleocr_vl_smart_resize: test the smart_resize function to verify it selects the best resolution for given dimensions
test_paddleocr_vl_get_num_patches: test the get_number_of_image_patches method to calculate patch counts for different image sizes
test_paddleocr_vl_backends_equivalence: test that all image processing backends produce equivalent pixel values and grid tensors
